reason: the owner's profile photo, decoded once per account load and replaced only when it changes, not a frame stream
single-instance monitors, installed once (guarded by monitors.isEmpty)
one shared monitor for every message bubble: installed when the first bubble enters a window, removed when the last leaves
single-instance monitor of the shortcut recorder (guarded by monitor == nil)
single window-scoped key monitor of the open bot chat, started on appear and removed on disappear; it only acts when no text input holds focus
single window-scoped monitor owned by the window chrome, removed in deinit
animation capped at 1/30 s and paused when not animated: working dots
animation capped at 1/30 s and paused under Reduce Motion: entering dot, removed from the tree once the avatar appears (900 ms)
animation capped at 1/30 s and paused under Reduce Motion: voice level meter
periodic every 1 s: recording elapsed clock
animation capped at 1/30 s and paused under Reduce Motion: sign-in backdrop
periodic every 30 s: relative timestamp label

drawn only for active moods, blinking avatars of 48 pt or more and the settle after a mood change, at 1/30 s (1/20 s under Reduce Motion); resting small avatars, paused avatars (inactive window, row avatar without the shared slot) are static (AvatarActivity.ticks); every entry lies on the shared 1/30 s grid (AvatarSchedule.onGrid)
one tracking area per animated avatar, event-driven and idle unless the pointer is inside; static avatars (animated: false) install none (AvatarActivity.tracksPointer)
